reason: ADR-0250 §14 moves the Agent Builder's agent tools (ADR-0220) out of lib/claude into a tools contribution. Their natural owner, the agent subsystem, is kernel, and a kernel subsystem cannot contribute tools without becoming a module that every kernel caller imports. So the tools become the agent-builder module (lib/agent-builder/module.ts), which reaches the builder's session and draft through the agent kernel's api files. The count rises by one; nothing is owed back, and phase 2 re-baselines the size measures once the transitional table is empty.
